marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Leading US technology conglomerates released quarterly earnings results showing double-digit growth in cloud computing revenues and announced increased capital expenditure plans dedicated to AI server buildouts.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capex commitments reinforce revenue visibility for semiconductor designers and server supply chain partners, providing structural support for the Nasdaq Composite.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of monetization lag in end-user software applications relative to heavy upfront hardware capital expenditure.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Platform Companies & Capital Return
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index experienced gains following announcements from major Chinese platform operators regarding accelerated share repurchase programs and margin expansion in core e-commerce segments.
marketLayer.inference: Heightened share buyback activity and disciplined cost structures establish a firmer valuation floor for HK tech equities, attracting income-focused and value-oriented capital.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of mainland Chinese retail sales recovery and ongoing promotional intensity within domestic e-commerce.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Outlook & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: Cooling US core inflation metrics alongside stable labor market data pushed futures pricing toward higher probabilities of a Federal Reserve interest rate reduction in upcoming FOMC meetings.
marketLayer.inference: Declining benchmark Treasury yields ease global risk-asset discount rates, helping reduce capital outflow pressures across emerging markets and HK-listed dividend stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential upside inflation shocks driven by supply chain dislocations or energy price volatility.

marketLayer.title: Chinese New Energy Vehicle (NEV) Sector
marketLayer.fact: Top-tier HK-listed EV manufacturers reported resilient monthly delivery figures alongside accelerating export sales volume to Southeast Asia and Latin American markets.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas market expansion is beginning to offset domestic price competition pressures, stabilizing gross margins for market leaders.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies and potential foreign tariff adjustments targeting imported electric vehicles.
